explanation: Exclusive pion electroproduction on a nucleon requires W >= M_N + m_pi ~ 938 + 140 = 1078 MeV (~1.078 GeV). The requested pion-channel point has W = 1.05 GeV, which is below threshold; no physical two-body pion final state exists, so EXCLURAD cannot compute radiative corrections for this kinematics. Request refused.
